blocks.tamil_translation: And (the responsibility of an Amir) will become a cause of disgrace and regret on the Day of Qiyamah, except for the one who takes on this responsibility in the right way and fulfils it as it ought to be fulfilled; (then this responsibility of an Amir) will not become a cause of disgrace and humiliation on the Day of Qiyamah,” Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمنِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ (لِيَ۞) النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: يَا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمنِ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ: لَا تَسْأََلِ اْلإِمَارَةَ فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ أُوتِيتَهَا عَنْ مَسْئَلَةٍ وُكِلْتَ إِلَيْهَا، وَإِنْ أُوتِيتَهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ مَسْئَلَةٍ أُعِنْتَ عَلَيْهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحديث) رواه البخاري، باب قول الله تبارك وتعالي لا يؤاخذكم الله....، رقم:٦٦٢٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “Do not ask for authority. If you ask and that authority is given to you, you will be left to the position itself. (Then you will receive no help or guidance from Allah Ta'ala.) If you are made Amir without asking, you will be helped in that position by Allah Ta'ala,” Hazrat Abdur-Rahman ibn Samurah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said to him.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّكُمْ سَتَحْرِصُونَ عَلَي اْلإِمَارَةِ وَسَتَكُونُ نَدَامَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، فَنِعْمَ الْمُرْضِعَةُ وَبِئْسَتِ الْفَاطِمَةُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب ما يكره من الحرص علي الامارة، رقم: ٧١٤٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “A time will come when you will be greedy to become Amir. But authority will become a cause of regret for you. Authority is like a woman who suckles: at the beginning it is very pleasant, but when weaning comes, that same thing becomes very hard,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.
